workarounds.symptom: [Bug] DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash + Engram: profiled SPS table (compact ragged verify) dies in CUDA-graph capture with "engram target-verify expects one equal block per request"
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Fix] dsv41: Run DSpark compact verify by mapping packed verify tokens to their requests. Target files: python/sglang/kernels/ops/embeddings/engram_hash.py, python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/deepseek_v4_backend.py, python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/dsv4/dsv41_sparse.py. With `SGLANG_RAGGED_VERIFY_MODE=compact`, DSpark target verify can pack unequal numbers of tokens per request. A compact CUDA graph tier can also hold more requests than full verify windows: for example, 42 tokens over 8 slots captures as `[6, 6, 5, 5, ... (Ref: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42718)
